description: This PHP source file defines the 'Category' class within the Goteo application's model layer, specifically related to call categories. It includes methods for retrieving, validating, saving, and removing categories associated with calls, interfacing with a database via PDO. It also manages localization through language-specific fields.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents a call category, providing static methods for retrieving categories, and instance methods for validation, saving, and removal.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns array of language-specific fields for localization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves categories associated with a specific call ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all categories, optionally localized, sorted by name.

methods.name: getNames
methods.description: Retrieves category names associated with a specific call, with optional limit and localization.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the category object, ensuring required fields are present.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates the category record in the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the association of a category from a specific call.
